name: Enchant Weapon - Rite of the Hash'ey
tooltip:
Enchant Weapon - Rite of the Hash'ey
Item Level 580
Use: Permanently enchants a weapon with Rite of the Hash'ey, causing your spells and abilities to grant you Hash'ey's Might, granting you 120 of a random secondary stat for 15 sec and favors your highest secondary stat when you're above 80% health. Cannot be applied to items lower than level 120.

Amani Augments - Zul'Aman Zeal
Requires Level 70
Max Stack: 200
Sell Price: 5
